proposal.title: Temporal Personal Data Exposure Detector
proposal.description: This skill detects and flags instances where personal identifiable information (PII) is exposed in temporal contexts, such as date of birth, age, or employment history, which can be used to infer sensitive information about an individual. It identifies patterns where PII is unnecessarily shared or discussed in a timeline, potentially compromising user anonymity.
proposal.rationale: Protecting human cognition from AI overreliance requires ensuring that personal data is not inadvertently exposed or misused. This skill helps prevent the unintended disclosure of sensitive information, thereby safeguarding users' privacy and maintaining their control over their personal data.
success_criteria: Detection accuracy > 85%
False positive rate < 10%
Compatible with existing PII detection skills

proposal.description: This skill detects when a user is uncritically accepting information from an AI output without considering alternative perspectives, and prompts them to reflect on the potential biases and assumptions in the information. It analyzes the user's interaction history and flags instances where the user has consistently accepted AI-generated content without questioning or exploring alternative viewpoints.
proposal.rationale: This skill matters for protecting human cognition because it helps users develop critical thinking skills and encourages them to engage in reflective thought, rather than simply accepting information at face value. By prompting users to consider alternative perspectives, this skill helps mitigate the risk of users becoming overly reliant on AI-generated content and neglecting their own critical thinking abilities.
success_criteria: Detects instances of unreflective consensus with 80% accuracy
Prompts users to consider alternative perspectives in 90% of detected instances
Reduces user acceptance of unverified AI-generated content by 20%
